subject: Acme — procurement & invoicing details / next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood trial — procurement & invoicing details

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can get you set up:

- Procurement path: you mentioned procurement will likely require a PO rather than a PCard. Can you confirm whether Acme will submit a formal PO or prefer to buy via AWS Marketplace (we can publish a listing to simplify procurement)?
- Billing terms: do you require Net 30, Net 45, or something else? Any approved Net terms in place already?
- Invoice format & required fields: please confirm AP needs (PDF invoice, PO number on invoice, remit-to address, tax/VAT ID). If you have a template, can you attach it?
- Contacts: please share the AP contact (name/email) and your procurement lead so we can route paperwork.

Attached is our pricing summary and a current W-9 for your finance team to review. If procurement wants a pro forma invoice, I can get finance to generate one — would you like that?

Next steps: Once you confirm PO vs marketplace and billing details we'll prepare a pro forma invoice and paperwork for signature (if needed). Happy to loop in Rishi (account exec) or Dev (solutions engineer) for any technical/contract clarifications.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf, W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial — procurement & invoicing details

Hi Marissa — great talking with you and the demo looked solid. Answers below:

- Procurement path: Acme prefers to issue a formal PO. Marketplace would be easier but procurement is not set up to use the marketplace for platform purchases right now.
- Billing terms: They typically approve Net 30, but finance wants to confirm with legal; assume Net 30 for now.
- Invoice format: AP requires a PDF invoice with the PO number, vendor remit-to address, and Redwood's tax ID (we'll need your VAT info if you have any EU entities). Please include a line-item breakdown (monthly committed capacity) and the total.
- AP contact: Karen Liu <karen.liu@acme-corp.com> — cc'd in procurement channel.

Yes, please send a pro forma invoice addressed to Acme Corp with the remit-to below. Procurement will create the PO after they receive the pro forma.

Billing / Remit-to:
Acme Corp
Accounts Payable
1234 Commerce Way
Seattle, WA 98101

Thanks — Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 17:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial — procurement & invoicing details

Awesome — thanks for the quick answers, Alex. We'll proceed with Net 30 pro forma and include the PO line-item breakdown and our tax ID.

Couple notes for internal tracking:
- We can accept a PO and Net 30 subject to a standard credit review. If Acme prefers marketplace later we can repurpose the contract but we won't hold up the PO path.
- I'll ask finance to generate a pro forma invoice today addressed to the remit-to you provided. Expect an email from billing@redwood.ai with the PDF.
- Dev / Rishi: please flag any legal/ops constraints. Also confirm if we need to include an EU VAT field (we only have a US entity listed in our W-9; VAT applies if Acme is EU-registered).

Marissa

From: Billing Ops <billing@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pro forma invoice — Redwood (Acme Corp) — RDW-4382

Hi Karen — per Marissa and Alex, attached is the pro forma invoice for Acme Corp (deal RDW-4382). This invoice is for initial committed capacity for the 3-month trial and includes a line-item breakdown. Payment terms listed: Net 30, payable to Redwood Inference.

Attached: proforma-invoice-acme-0626.pdf

Please confirm the PO number once issued so we can apply it to the invoice. If your team requires any additional fields on the PDF (tax ID placement, VAT fields, or alternative remit address) let us know and we can re-issue.

Thanks,
Billing Operations
billing@redwood.ai

Attachment: proforma-invoice-acme-0626.pdf

Subject: Re: Pro forma invoice — Redwood (Acme Corp) — RDW-4382

Thanks — received the pro forma. Finance will generate a PO by EOD next Wednesday (07/01) and we'll send it back to billing@redwood.ai. One request: can you include Redwood's federal tax ID on the invoice as a separate line? Also confirm whether Redwood can accept electronic PO attachments (pdf) or if you need a signed paper copy.

Karen Liu
